title: .NET 10 API Feature Endpoints Implementation and Concurrency Tests
acceptance_criteria: Implementation of all 10+ endpoints: Inventory CRUD, FEFO sorting, ETag item consumption, Meal logging, Macro target setting, Recipe recommendations, 1-Click Cook, Barcode lookup, Household Shopping List sync.
Optimistic Concurrency validation (409 Conflict when ETag mismatch on item consumption).
Domain invariant enforcement (422 Unprocessable Content when inventory insufficient for cook).
xUnit unit and concurrency tests verifying optimistic locking, idempotency, and rate limiting.
